main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return in long blocks minus mean over all blocks

statistic.name: Welch t (long blocks vs all blocks)

main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; excess <= 0 rejects (t <= -2 means reversal)

supporting_check.name: hit rate of long blocks minus hit rate of all blocks (long 0.4827586206896552, all 0.5142857142857142; slope of return on forecast: -0.00027366833536417406)

decided_by: Inconclusive: excess > 0 but t between 0 and 2.
reading: Blocks start at rows 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with returns kept inside the window; long means forecast > 0 at the block start; the t is Welch's long-blocks vs all-blocks; per-window excess is the window's long mean minus its all-block mean; 'carried by a single window' means the pooled excess drops to <= 0 when any one window is removed; the forecast-slope view is reported but does not enter the decision since the confirm rule omits it.
